thread:
maya: Quick sync — planning the launch newsletter send for next Tuesday. Need to lock send windows by timezone, an IP warmup plan for the new sending domain, and simple routing rules for inbound demo requests that come from the newsletter. Anyone got bandwidth to own the deliverability checklist?

ethan: I can own the timezone windows. Proposal: 3 staggered waves to hit peak open times local to recipients (US East 9am, US West 9am PT, EMEA 10am local). Keep APAC to a separate cadence next week.

rachel: +1 on waves. Also we should apply frequency cap: no more than 2 marketing sends/week for contacts in the last 30d. What segments are we using for the launch cohort?

maya: Segment plan: 1) Active product users (last 30d), 2) Trial starters (last 45d, no conversion), 3) MQLs (lead score >= 30), 4) Re-engagement (inactive 180+ days) — re-engagement gets different subject and a suppression window.

owen: For IP warmup I recommend this schedule (assuming new dedicated IP):
- Day 1: 1k low-risk opens (internal + known good contacts)
- Day 2: 5k
- Day 3-4: ramp to 25k/day
- Day 5+: target full traffic
Also warmup with consistent volume and engagement. Avoid large blasts to re-engage segment until IP has good reputation.

deliverability-bot: Reminder: Re-engagement segment must be suppressed if hard bounces > 0.5% during any warmup day. Also check DKIM/SPF/DMARC records before send.

ethan: Routing rules idea for inbound demo requests from newsletter: set utm_medium=newsletter then auto-tag as "newsletter-demo" -> route to SDR pool A (higher intent) if lead_score >= 50, else to SDR pool B. Also add SLA: 4 business hours to respond.

rachel: Can we add a simple sample CSV for the segmentation team so they can export? Something like:
```
email,segment,timezone,lead_score,last_active
alice@example.com,trial,America/New_York,12,2026-02-10
bob@example.com,mql,America/Los_Angeles,55,2026-03-01
carol@example.com,active,Europe/London,78,2026-03-05
```

maya: Perfect — @ethan please produce the send windows calendar and share send-ready batches by EOD Friday. @owen please own the IP warmup runbook and make sure devops has DKIM/SPF entries live. Rachel, can you finalize subject/body variants for the re-engage group?

owen: Will do. I'll post the IP warmup checklist in this thread when done.

rachel: I'll A/B test two re-engage subject lines and push final copy to the content folder by Friday.

ethan: Sharing the tentative waves doc: https://drive.redwood/marketing/send-windows (will update with exact batch sizes).

maya: Thanks team — one last note: include a short preheader that mentions the benchmark webinar link for credibility. Keep tests small on the warmup days. :thumbsup:
